Original BananaOS in-game menu, vendored from the pinned BananaFront source.
Preserved renderer, navigation, slot screens, dialogs, brightness and translations.
Duo integration changes: height-based widescreen scaling, native backlight names,
and refreshing per-game metadata when used by the persistent launcher.
ra_compat.c provides no separate achievements session; the existing game panel owns it.
See COPYING and UPSTREAM.json for provenance.
